title: Stamp started only when tadu set moves a task into in_progress
notes: Observed 2026-11-18 in the vexa backlog: `tadu set ID type=perf priority=high` on 36 tasks already `in_progress` without `started` (migrated from format 1) wrote `"started": "<today>"`, a false first-day date, and `tadu set ID started=` then refuses ("set by tadu itself").

Cause: `tadu/run_set.py:30` tests only the new state (`task.get("state") == "in_progress" and "started" not in task`), not the transition the spec describes ("moving to in_progress sets started once").
Next step: also require `old.task.get("state") != "in_progress"`, plus a test that setting another field on such a task leaves `started` absent.
result: run_task_change stamps started only on a move into in_progress.
evidence: tests/test_mark_in_both_formats.py::test_set_on_a_task_already_in_progress_does_not_stamp_started fails without the change and passes with it; full suite 2247 passed, ruff, mypy clean
